entite: S5.5 — Douleur, brûlure, crampe ou engourdissement des extrémités

passages.source: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of peripheral arterial and aortic diseases — section8.1.3
passages.texte: Neurological deficits (sensory loss or especially motor deficit) are signs of limb threat and require emergency imaging and revascularization.

passages.source: Peripheral arterial disease: differential diagnosis — NICE CKS
passages.texte: Chronic compartment syndrome, venous claudication, and symptomatic Baker's cyst — these are less common. Spinal stenosis — often bilateral pain and weakness affecting the buttocks and posterior leg. Worse on standing, relieved by flexing the lumbar spine.
